    Incidence tables and faithful supports of ray tables #

    • inc Q: the incidence table of a finite poset; its linearization is the incidence algebra (incEquiv), so the forbidden configurations of FinPoset apply to it.
    • Faithful projective support (def:faithful-support): the rays from x in a finite set T, ordered by r ≤ s if r v = s for a ray v. Its incidence table is a quotient of the graded cover on the objects (tgt r, wt r) (the action on H(X, -)), so it is representation-finite when kP is (Lemma 4.10).
